messages:
emily: Postmortem follow-up from yesterday's external-auth rollout. We saw repeated auth-timeout alerts spike when we scaled - looks like two recurring patterns: noisy threshold (rapid transient latencies) + dedupe not catching ~3m bursts. Action items below, need owners + ETA by EOD.

emily: Action list (high-level):
1) Tune auth-timeout alert threshold and eval percentile window.
2) Increase dedupe window / add heuristic to paging rule for auth-timeout.
3) Quiet-window for non-prod routes (23:00-06:00) so we don't page overnight.
4) Runbook update: remediation steps + rollback for auth rollout.
5) Post-implementation smoke test and monitoring dashboard widget.

emily: Please reply with owner and conservative ETA.

raj: I can take #1 (threshold tuning). Will run a short analysis against last 72h p95/p99. ETA: 24h.

taylor: I'll own #2 (dedupe + paging rule). Quick thought: current dedupe is 2m, maybe bump to 6m for auth-timeout only. Also add suppression for identical trace ids. ETA: 72h.

sre-bot: New ticket created: INFR-4521 - "auth-timeout dedupe and paging rule changes" (assigned to taylor).

maria: I'll handle #4 runbook edits + add explicit rollback play. Will sync with oncall for steps. ETA: EOW.

emily: Thanks. raj, when you tune thresholds can you share the query + snippet you used so we can reproduce?

raj: yep. query I used:
```
sum(rate(auth_request_latency_ms_bucket[5m])) by (le)
```
Plan: compare p95/p99 across prod vs rollout periods, then adjust alert to p99 > 800ms for 5m window as starting point. Will test in staging first.

jon: I can put the quiet-window in alerting now for non-prod routes (23:00-06:00 local). That should prevent pages overnight. Will mark in config. ETA: 2h.

dave: I'll create the postmortem follow-up doc + action tracker (spreadsheet) and ping owners. Link when ready.

emily: +1 thanks. Also requirement: add a smoke test to CI that hits auth endpoint with a burst pattern so we catch regressions before rollout. Who can add that?

maria: I can add a basic smoke test example to the runbook, but devs need to add to CI. I'll coordinate.

raj: quick note: if we bump dedupe to 6m we should still keep a short notification path for high-severity sustained errors (>=10m). We shouldn't blind all long incidents.

taylor: agreed. plan: dedupe 6m for transient bursts + a separate rule that if error rate > X for 10m escalate immediately.

emily: Nice. Final owner recap: raj=#1 (24h), taylor=#2 (72h), jon=#3 (2h), maria=#4 (EOW), dave=action-tracker doc (4h). If anyone needs to swap, call it out now.

jon: ack. I'll attach the PR for quiet-window once merged.

dave: doc created: https://redwood/doc/infr/pm-auth-followup (tracking INFR-4520/4521). I'll update with timestamps.

emily: Great. We'll reconvene in 48h in this thread for status. Thanks all :thumbsup:
